title: Motion to adjust the Civil List for the President's office from FY2025
what_it_is: A motion moved in Parliament under section 7 of the Civil List and Gratuity Act 1970 to vary the Schedule to that Act, raising three figures that fund the President's office.
why_it_matters: The motion changes the amounts set aside for the President's personal staff, the household, and seconded public officers, with the changes taking effect from FY2025. The Minister stated that no change is proposed to the President's salary and allowance. The record does not set out the practical impact on ordinary people.

key_points.point: The Minister moved that Parliament vary the Schedule to the Civil List and Gratuity Act 1970 by replacing three figures in the second column.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: I move that this Parliament, pursuant to section 7 of the Civil List and Gratuity Act 1970, resolves that the Schedule to that Act be varied

key_points.point: No change is proposed to the President's salary and allowance under Class 1.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: no change is proposed in this Motion to the President's salary and allowance

key_points.point: Class 2 expenditure, for the salaries of the President's personal staff, is proposed to rise from $6,696,700 to $7,318,000.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: it is proposed to increase the sum from $6,696,700 to $7,318,000

key_points.point: Class 3 expenditure, for household expenses, is proposed to rise from $3,342,200 to $4,542,000.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: it is proposed to increase the sum from $3,342,200 to $4,542,000

key_points.point: Class 4 expenditure is proposed to rise from $550,000 to $1,288,000.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: it is proposed to increase the sum from $550,000 to $1,288,000

key_points.point: The Class 3 increase is to cover higher costs of maintaining and securing IT systems and organising official events at the Istana while the main building undergoes major restoration works.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: This is to cater for the higher cost of maintaining and securing IT systems as well as organising official events at the Istana

key_points.point: Expenditure on manpower for public officers seconded to the President's office will be categorised under Class 4 instead of Class 2, because they are not part of the President's personal staff.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: expenditure on manpower for public officers seconded to the President's office will now be categorised under Class 4

key_points.point: The changes take effect from FY2025.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: The changes will take effect from FY2025.

key_points.point: The Speaker put the question as moved by the Minister and asked whether anyone wished to speak.
key_points.speaker: Mr Speaker
key_points.quote: The question is as moved by the Minister.

what_happens_next: The Speaker put the question as moved by the Minister and asked whether anyone wished to speak; the transcript records no further step.
not_said: Whether any Member spoke on the motion.
Whether the motion was voted on or agreed to.
What the total Civil List amount will be after the variations.
Whether the re-categorisation of seconded officers' manpower costs changes total spending or only its classification.
